items.title: RBI flags widening inflation risks, puts rate cuts on ice
items.summary: RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation concerns. Governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated a generalisation of inflation, with many commodities exceeding 4% inflation. Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta highlighted the influence of external supply-side shocks on inflation projections. External members expressed concerns about the implications of an aggressive rate hike on economic growth.

items.title: Slew of Sops to help fuel ships' shift to methanol

The government plans to implement tax concessions and flexible compliance to encourage this shift. Work is already in progress to improve local availability and establish refueling facilities.

items.title: HDFC Bank begins probe into alleged internal data leak

This internal review aims to assess compliance with the bank's code of conduct and governance standards. The investigation specifically examines communications involving senior management and other sensitive issues. HDFC Bank confirmed the review process after allegations arose regarding two senior executives' involvement.

items.title: Critical tech list under review to push self-reliance
items.summary: India's Niti Aayog is preparing a list of critical technologies for enhancing self-reliance and investment. This initiative aims to protect against disruptions due to limited access to essential technologies. Potential technologies include 6G, defence equipment, and electric vehicle powertrains. The government seeks to encourage innovation through the Anusandhan National Research Foundation and other funds. A comprehensive roadmap is expected to be finalized and released next month.

items.title: 'Ease non-tariff curbs to ensure alcohol enters the market freely'

"Even with tariffs reduced, the products still get sampled and tested," he said, but added: "Obviously, alcohol and all food products need to be regulated. We're not arguing against that."

items.title: SBI investigates dark web leak of 3.8 lakh records
items.summary: State Bank of India is currently investigating a suspected data breach involving customer information found online. The breach reportedly exposed around 375,000 records containing personally identifiable information. SBI activated protocols and engaged cybersecurity experts to assess the extent of the breach. Preliminary analysis revealed that 3,897 customer records included sensitive personal data. Despite this incident, the bank's core business operations and financial performance remain unaffected.

items.title: Core output grows at series high of 7.9% in Sept
items.summary: India's core sector output growth for September recorded a remarkable 7.9%, driven largely by expansion in coal and electricity. Notably, refinery products and iron ore also contributed to this growth, supported by a favorable base effect. Coal production saw a sharp rebound with a growth rate of 10.7% following previous negative trends. Electricity generation growth declined slightly, impacted by heatwave conditions in the country.

items.title: Fabindia looks beyond its 'heritage' to revive growth and cash flow

The divestment marked Fabindia's exit from the organic foods business, leaving it focused on apparel, home furnishings and lifestyle products.
